headline: 234 caps, 146 goals: Ronaldo announces Portugal retirement
summary: The 41-year-old football legend retires from international football, ending a 23-year career with the national team.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his intention to retire from the Portugal national team on Thursday, ending one of the most illustrious international careers in football history.
The 41-year-old star will officially hand back the iconic number 7 shirt after the November international break.
Ronaldo's legacy includes captaining Portugal to their first major trophy at Euro 2016 and winning the 2019 and 2025 Nations Leagues.
In an emotional social media post, Ronaldo stated that the decision was made with the heart, thanking his family, the Portuguese people, and his teammates and coaches.
He expressed that if his goals ever made people feel proud of their country, then his entire journey was worth it.
Statistically, Ronaldo leaves as the all-time record holder for both international appearances with 234 caps and international goals with 146.
Portugal will always be a part of me, he captioned his announcement video.
caption:
234 appearances and 146 goals. The end of an era for Portuguese football.

Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his intention to retire from the Portugal national team on Thursday, ending one of the most illustrious international careers in football history.

The 41-year-old star will officially hand back the iconic number 7 shirt after the November international break.

Ronaldo's legacy includes captaining Portugal to their first major trophy at Euro 2016 and winning the 2019 and 2025 Nations Leagues.

In an emotional social media post, Ronaldo stated that the decision was made with the heart, thanking his family, the Portuguese people, and his teammates and coaches.

He expressed that if his goals ever made people feel proud of their country, then his entire journey was worth it.

Statistically, Ronaldo leaves as the all-time record holder for both international appearances with 234 caps and international goals with 146.

Portugal will always be a part of me, he captioned his announcement video.

headline: Chaos at court: Pori Moni snatches journalist's phone, abuses reporters
summary: The actress secured bail in an assault case but her appearance triggered chaotic scenes, with reports of a court visitor sustaining a head injury.
details: Actress Pori Moni allegedly snatched a journalist's mobile phone and verbally abused reporters as she left the Dhaka Chief Judicial Magistrate Court on Thursday.
The actress had arrived to surrender and seek bail in a case filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud over allegations of assault, vandalism, and intimidation.
Chaos erupted as Pori Moni was escorted by around 11 security guards in black, who allegedly pushed and jostled journalists trying to record the proceedings.
A court visitor, Sujan Chandra Moni Das, reportedly sustained a head injury and was seen bleeding after being pushed by the actress's security guards.
During the incident, Pori Moni allegedly snatched the phone of Samakal multimedia reporter Robiul Hossain as he attempted to record a video.
The court granted her bail on a Tk 500 bond after a hearing before Acting Judge Mahfuzur Rahman.
The case stems from a 2022 filing by Nasir Uddin, with a PBI report later substantiating allegations of assault and intimidation against Pori Moni and Junaid Bogdadi Jimmy.
caption:
A journalist's phone snatched and a court visitor left bleeding. Chaos erupted as actress Pori Moni appeared in court.

Actress Pori Moni allegedly snatched a journalist's mobile phone and verbally abused reporters as she left the Dhaka Chief Judicial Magistrate Court on Thursday.

The actress had arrived to surrender and seek bail in a case filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud over allegations of assault, vandalism, and intimidation.

Chaos erupted as Pori Moni was escorted by around 11 security guards in black, who allegedly pushed and jostled journalists trying to record the proceedings.

A court visitor, Sujan Chandra Moni Das, reportedly sustained a head injury and was seen bleeding after being pushed by the actress's security guards.

During the incident, Pori Moni allegedly snatched the phone of Samakal multimedia reporter Robiul Hossain as he attempted to record a video.

The court granted her bail on a Tk 500 bond after a hearing before Acting Judge Mahfuzur Rahman.

The case stems from a 2022 filing by Nasir Uddin, with a PBI report later substantiating allegations of assault and intimidation against Pori Moni and Junaid Bogdadi Jimmy.
